scenarioSet.description: Explicit v2 binding of the preserved thirteen EVO intents to cached native clocks. Conditional on complete publication, one host and static state. Source-derived cache-day inputs are recorded separately. Old delay has no recognized adapter. EVO-PACE uses finite short mode and cannot prove short-clock cadence.
